name: Fieldset

examples.title: Basic Usage
examples.code:
<Fieldset legend="Shipping address">
  <Input label="Street" name="street" />
  <Input label="City" name="city" />
</Fieldset>

examples.title: Variants
examples.code:
<Columns>
  <Column>
    <Fieldset legend="Default">
      <Input label="Street" name="street-default" />
    </Fieldset>
  </Column>
  <Column>
    <Fieldset variant="filled" legend="Filled">
      <Input label="Street" name="street-filled" />
    </Fieldset>
  </Column>
  <Column>
    <Fieldset variant="unstyled" legend="Unstyled">
      <Input label="Street" name="street-unstyled" />
    </Fieldset>
  </Column>
</Columns>

examples.title: With a Message
examples.code:
<Fieldset
  legend="Contact"
  message="Fill in the phone number or the email."
  messageColor="info"
>
  <Input label="Phone" name="phone" type="tel" />
  <Input label="Email" name="email" type="email" />
</Fieldset>

examples.title: Horizontal Fields
examples.code:
<Fieldset legend="Contact details">
  <Input horizontal label="Phone" name="phone" type="tel" />
  <Input horizontal label="Email" name="email" type="email" />
  <Field horizontal label="Subject">
    <Control>
      <Select name="subject">
        <option>Business</option>
        <option>Support</option>
      </Select>
    </Control>
  </Field>
</Fieldset>

examples.title: Disabled
examples.code:
<Fieldset legend="Preferences" disabled>
  <Input label="Display name" name="display-name" defaultValue="Ada" />
  <Rate label="Rating" name="rating" defaultValue={3} />
  <Slider label="Volume" name="volume" defaultValue={40} />
  <Checkboxes label="Notifications" name="notifications">
    <Checkbox value="email">Email</Checkbox>
    <Checkbox value="sms">SMS</Checkbox>
  </Checkboxes>
</Fieldset>

examples.title: Turned On From the Legend
Disabling a Form While It Saves

accessibility:
- **Name:** the legend names the group natively, so a screen reader announces it as a group
  called "Shipping address" with no ids to wire. A Fieldset with no legend is an unnamed group,
  which is fine for one that's only there to disable a form. Screen readers differ in how often
  they repeat a legend, so keep it short and the labels inside complete on their own.
- **Description:** the `message` is the group's description through `aria-describedby`, added to
  any ids you pass there.
- **Errors:** nothing marks the group invalid, since ARIA deprecates `aria-invalid` on a group.
  Put each input's error on that input with its own `color` and `message`.
- **Disabled:** native controls are disabled and left out of the form's data, and bestax's own
  widgets, such as `Rate` and the time wheels, leave the tab order and ignore input. An input's
  own `disabled`, when you set it, wins over the Fieldset's, though the browser keeps its native
  parts disabled. Controls in the legend stay enabled, and a Fieldset inside a disabled one is
  disabled too.
- **Not disabled:** links, `LinkButton`s and anything else that isn't a form control stay
  operable, as in plain HTML, so disable or hide those yourself.
- **Forced colors:** the border takes the system's text color, since the backgrounds are
  replaced there.
summary: The `Fieldset` component groups a section of a form in a native `<fieldset>`, named by its `legend`, which a `disabled` switches off as a whole. It starts its own Field scope: inside it, nothing reads as inside a `Field` or `Control`, so the convenience inputs render their own `Field`, and a labeled `Field` around the Fieldset names nothing in it.

parts.summary: The `Fieldset` component groups a section of a form in a native `<fieldset>`, named by its `legend`, which a `disabled` switches off as a whole. It starts its own Field scope: inside it, nothing reads as inside a `Field` or `Control`, so the convenience inputs render their own `Field`, and a labeled `Field` around the Fieldset names nothing in it.

props.name: legend
props.description: The group's name, shown in a `<legend>`, which names the fieldset with no ids to wire. The `default` and `filled` variants draw it on the border, and `unstyled` above the content. Controls you put in it, such as a `Checkbox` that turns the section on, stay enabled when the Fieldset is disabled, as the browser leaves them.

props.name: legendProps
props.description: Props for the `<legend>`, such as an `id` or a `className`.

props.name: variant
props.description: The look: `default` draws a border round the group, `filled` adds a tinted background, and `unstyled` draws no box at all, which suits a Fieldset that's there to name or disable a group.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every control inside. The browser disables the native ones and leaves them out of the form's data, and each bestax input with a `disabled` prop takes this as that prop's default, which also stops widgets the browser doesn't reach, such as `Rate`'s stars and the time wheels, and gives them their disabled look. An input's own `disabled` still wins when you set it, though the browser keeps its native parts disabled whatever it says. Links and `LinkButton`s stay operable, as in plain HTML.

props.name: message
props.description: Help text under the group. It describes the fieldset through `aria-describedby`, alongside any ids you pass there. Nothing passes it to the inputs, so each still shows its own errors.

props.name: textColor
props.description: Text color helper, for the text in the group. The legend keeps its own color.

props.name: children
props.description: The group's content, such as `Field`s and inputs.

extraProps.name: ref
extraProps.description: Ref forwarded to the `<fieldset>`, whose `elements` lists the controls inside.

extraProps.name: aria-describedby
extraProps.description: Ids of more text that describes the group. The `message`'s id is added after them.

extraProps.name: name
extraProps.description: The fieldset's name in its form's `elements`. Nothing is submitted under it.
